newsitem.title: USA: W House's Raines sees continued expansion in 1997.
newsitem.headline: W House's Raines sees continued expansion in 1997.

text.p: White House budget director Franklin Raines said Friday he expects U.S. economic expansion to continue in 1997 and inflation to stay at favorable levels.

"We are confident that we are going to see continuation of the economic expansion that we've experienced," Raines told reporters before speaking at a luncheon of the National Contract Management Association.
Asked about the inflation outlook for next year, Raines said, "We expect (it) to continue at very favorable levels."
He declined to comment on Congressional Budget Office economic assumptions released Thursday.
